controlChangeCommands.name: Expression
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Expression pedal. Official ME-90 Reference Manual / FS-1-WL Connection Guide: CC#11, 0-127. USB/Bluetooth MIDI only (no DIN/TRS MIDI jack).

controlChangeCommands.name: CTL Pedal
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: [CTL] pedal. Press=127, release=0. In memory mode assigns multi-effect on/off or one knob value; in manual mode turns REV on/off.

controlChangeCommands.name: EXP SW
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Pedal effect ON/OFF (EXP SW / expression toe switch). ON=127, OFF=0.
